faq.metaDesc: Frequently asked questions about Fresh Nest Co. cleaning services in Cornwall, Akwesasne, Snye QC, Long Sault, and Morrisburg.
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subhead: Quick answers about booking, services, and what to expect.
faq.ctaSubhead: We're happy to help — call us or request a quote online.

item1.q: Do I need to be home during the clean?
item1.a: No, you don't need to be home. Many of our clients provide a key or entry code. We follow your access instructions and lock up securely when we leave.

item2.q: Do you use eco-friendly, pet-safe products?
item2.a: Yes. We use plant-based, non-toxic cleaning products that are safe for children and pets. If you have specific sensitivities or product preferences, just let us know at booking.

item3.q: Will I get the same cleaner every time?
item3.a: Yes — we assign you a dedicated cleaner whenever possible. Consistency matters for trust and quality, so we make it a priority for recurring clients.

item4.q: Do you serve Cornwall Island / Akwesasne?
item4.a: Yes, we cross the bridge to Cornwall Island and serve the Akwesasne community. Please mention your address when booking so we can confirm scheduling.

item5.q: Do you travel to Snye, QC?
item5.a: Yes, we travel to Snye on the Quebec side of Akwesasne. We use eco-friendly, pet-safe products — important for families along the river. Mention your Snye address at booking.

item6.q: What's included in the Airbnb turnover package?
item6.a: Our Airbnb turnover includes a full clean, linen change, restocking of toiletries, and damage-documentation photos. Turnovers are typically completed in the 11am–3pm window to meet check-in deadlines.

item7.q: Can I reschedule or cancel my booking?
item7.a: Yes. Please give us at least 24 hours' notice for standard residential and Airbnb turnover cleanings, and at least 48 hours' notice for deep, move-out, post-construction, and commercial cleanings. Cancellations or reschedules with less notice — or visits where our team cannot access the property upon arrival (lockout) — are subject to a late cancellation or lockout fee as outlined in your quote and booking confirmation.

item8.a: Yes, Fresh Nest Co. is fully insured and bonded. You can book with confidence knowing your home and belongings are protected.

item9.q: What if I'm not happy with the clean, or how do I report an issue?
item9.a: We stand behind our work with a 24-hour satisfaction guarantee. If anything from your booked cleaning checklist was missed, please call or email us within 24 hours of your clean (photos are always helpful). We will return within 24 to 48 hours for a complimentary re-clean of the missed areas. Because homes are lived in right away, we do not offer cash refunds, and concerns reported more than 24 hours after completion are outside the guarantee.

item10.q: What payment methods do you accept?
item10.a: We accept cash and Interac e-Transfer. Payment is due on the day of service, or according to your invoice terms for recurring and commercial accounts. Overdue balances past the grace period are subject to a late payment fee as outlined in your agreement, and future scheduled visits may be paused until the account is brought up to date.

aboutPage.metaDesc: Learn about Fresh Nest Co. — our story, mission, eco-friendly values, and service coverage in Cornwall, Akwesasne, and Snye QC.
aboutPage.title: About Us

story.title: Our Story
story.content: Fresh Nest Co. was founded in Cornwall, Ontario with a simple mission: to provide premium, reliable, and eco-friendly cleaning services that local families can trust. As a local, family-owned business, we care deeply about our neighbors, our team, and the environment.

mission.title: Our Mission & Values
mission.content: To deliver exceptional cleaning services while prioritizing sustainability, community respect, and fair employment. We believe that a clean home is a happy home, and that starts with an empowered, background-checked team.

community.title: Community Commitment
community.content: We are proud to serve the entire Cornwall and Akwesasne region. Unlike other services, we explicitly serve Cornwall Island (Akwesasne) and cross the provincial border to Snye, QC. We respect the unique logistics and community structures of each area we serve and are proud to be a trusted local partner.

eco.title: Eco-Friendly & Baby-Safe
eco.content: We care about the health of your family, your pets, and our planet. That's why we use 100% baby-safe, eco-friendly, and non-toxic products on every clean. From new babies to beloved pets, we keep your home spotless without harmful chemicals or strong fragrances.

careersPage.metaDesc: Join the Fresh Nest Co. team. We offer competitive pay, paid training, and eco-friendly cleaning positions in Cornwall, ON.
careersPage.title: Join Our Team
careersPage.subhead: Build a rewarding career with a supportive, local business that values your work.

benefits.title: Why Work With Us?
benefits.payDesc: We offer industry-leading wages and performance bonuses.
benefits.ecoDesc: Work with 100% non-toxic, baby-safe, and fragrance-free cleaning products.
benefits.trainingDesc: No experience? No problem. We provide paid training and ongoing support.
benefits.hoursDesc: Create a schedule that fits your life and family commitments.

openings.title: Current Openings

apply.content: Ready to join the nest? Please send your resume and a brief description of your availability to hello@freshnestco.ca or call us at (613) 861-8812.

privacyPage.metaDesc: How Fresh Nest Co. collects, uses and protects your personal information under PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Fresh Nest Co. respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you request a quote or use our website, why we collect it, and the choices you have. It follows Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and Quebec's Law 25.

1.title: 1. Information we collect
1.content:
When you request a quote or book a cleaning, we collect only what we need to provide the service:
• Your name, email address, phone number and service address
• Details about your home or business and the cleaning you need, your preferred date and any notes you add (for example, entry instructions)
• Your preferred language (English or French)
• Whether you chose to receive promotional emails, and when

If you sign in to your customer account, we also keep your sign-in email. If you accept analytics cookies, we collect anonymous information about how the website is used.

2.title: 2. How we use it
2.content:
We use your information to:
• Contact you about your request, prepare your quote and schedule your cleaning
• Send confirmations, reminders and service updates by email or text message, in your chosen language
• Assign a cleaner and give them the address and instructions needed for the visit
• Keep the business records we are required to keep

We send promotional emails only if you ticked the consent box, and you can unsubscribe at any time. We do not sell your information or use it for any other purpose.

3.title: 3. Who we share it with
3.content:
We share your information only with service providers that help us run the service, and only as much as each one needs:
• Google Firebase — website hosting, our secure database and account sign-in
• Twilio — text message delivery
• Resend — email delivery
• Google Analytics — anonymous website statistics, only if you accept analytics cookies
• Sentry — technical error reports so we can fix problems on the website

These providers may store data in Canada or the United States. Each is bound by its own privacy and security commitments. We never share your information with advertisers or data brokers.

4.title: 4. How long we keep it and how we protect it
4.content: We keep booking records for 7 years, as required for tax and business records, and then delete them. Access to your information is limited to authorized Fresh Nest Co. staff who sign in to protected systems. Our website stores only your language choice and your cookie preference in your browser — never your contact details.

5.title: 5. Your rights and how to contact us
5.content:
You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or withdraw your consent to promotional emails at any time. Quebec residents have these rights under Law 25, and we extend them to all our clients.

To make a request or ask a question, contact our privacy officer at hello@freshnestco.ca or (613) 861-8812. We will respond within 30 days.

If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or, in Quebec, the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.
